component.name: Fan Control
component.summary: Manage cooling on HP Victus and OMEN laptops

description.p: Take control of cooling on supported HP Victus and OMEN laptops. Choose the right thermal profile for your work and check both fans at a glance.

ul.li: Choose Quiet, Cool, Balanced, or Performance when supported by your firmware
Run both fans at maximum speed, then switch back to automatic cooling
See live CPU and GPU fan speeds, updated every second
Follow your desktop's light or dark appearance

description.p: Changes require administrator authentication. Max fan speed stays active when you close the app; turn it off to restore automatic cooling.
This app supports HP firmware controls and does not provide custom fan curves or arbitrary RPM targets. Availability depends on your laptop and Linux driver.

Host-command access is required. The host must provide Python 3.10 or newer, polkit, coreutils, and a graphical authentication agent. No companion service package is needed. Preview mode works without supported hardware.
